Thea Ramaswell opened it on 4 Oct 2025 because drivers at the Eau Claire yard weren't getting text messages telling them which dock bay to use when they checked in at the gate. Support fixed it that evening.
- **#4419** is in "Moss: North cheat sheet (undated)" (`teams/team-north/digests/north-account-cheatsheet.md`). Thea logged it because the gate's barcode scanners couldn't read trailer tags at Door 14. It was passed to second-level support to test the scanner firmware.

I read all six of Moss's notes, and Dana can open every one of them. The other four have no ticket number for this account. #4409, #4412 and FR-882 appear in one of them but belong to Central team accounts, so I left them out. I also told Dana not to confuse this account with Quarendon Freightways, which isn't a customer.

The search in gbrain (the knowledge brain) was refused, and nothing was read from it. Its access isn't tied to individual members yet, so it can't filter results to what Dana is allowed to see. The list comes only from the shared files. I didn't try to change gbrain's access settings myself. Whoever runs the gbrain server would need to make that change on the server.
